title: Black Nobility & Allied Dynasties Deck
subtitle: A 52-card historical-genealogical influence map of Roman papal nobility, Venetian and Genoese patrician houses, Italian princely dynasties, and related European aristocratic networks.
boundary: This is a historical-genealogical influence deck. Inclusion reflects documented historical relevance, institutional proximity, dynastic continuity, property, patronage, church proximity, finance, maritime, court or marriage-network routes. It is not proof of secret control, collective intent, unlawful conduct or wrongdoing.
note: Baseline data file. The build-black-nobility-deck script regenerates the full 52-card data, card wall, assets and dossier pages.
